# Functional Test Cases of the Prototype {#sec-appendix-functional-tests}

| Post | Text | Humanitarian Category | Entities |
|:-----|:------------------------------|:----------------|:------------------------------|
| P1 | "Need po namin ng rescue dito sa Brgy. Tumana, hanggang bubong na ang tubig" | Requests or urgent needs | REQUEST = "Need po namin ng rescue". LOCATION = "Brgy. Tumana" |
| P2 | "Signal No. 3 na sa Quezon dahil kay Bagyong Henry, stay indoors everyone" | Caution and advice | NUMBER = "Signal No. 3". LOCATION = "Quezon". DISASTER_TYPE = "Bagyong Henry" |
| P3 | "Nagpadala ang Philippine Red Cross ng relief goods sa evacuation center" | Rescue, volunteering, or donation effort | ORGANIZATION = "Philippine Red Cross". RESOURCE = "relief goods" |
| P4 | "Praying for everyone affected by the baha, ingat kayong lahat" | Sympathy and support | None |
| P5 | "Almost 200 families na ang nasa covered court ng Marikina" | Displaced people and evacuations | DISPLACED = "Almost 200 families". LOCATION = "Marikina" |
| P6 | "\@juan_dc baha na sa kalsada namin, please send help sa Barangay Malanday" | Requests or urgent needs | REQUEST = "please send help". LOCATION = "Barangay Malanday" |

: Constructed Test Posts and Their Fixed Labels {#tbl-functional-test-posts tbl-colwidths="[6,40,20,34]"}

| Test Case ID | Use Case | Functional Requirement | Pre-requisites | Test Data | Step Details | Expected Result | Actual Result | Status |
|:----|:--------|:------------|:--------|:--------|:------------|:------------|:-------|:----|
| FT-01 | Retrieve posts from X | The system shall retrieve posts from the X API, replace their personal details with placeholders, label each post with the final model, and store the posts with their labels | The database is empty, and a stand-in for the X API returns the texts of P1 to P6 | Texts of P1 to P6 | The researcher starts the retrieval of new posts | The database holds six posts, each with one humanitarian category and its entities, and the username in P6 is replaced with a placeholder |  |  |
| FT-02 | Retrieve posts from X | The system shall label the retrieved posts in the same way as the final model in the evaluation | The database is empty, and a stand-in for the X API returns 20 posts of the test set | 20 posts of the test set and the labels that the final model gave them in the evaluation | The researcher starts the retrieval of new posts | Each of the 20 posts has the same humanitarian category and the same entities as in the evaluation |  |  |
| FT-03 | Retrieve posts from X | The system shall replace the phone numbers, email addresses, and links of the retrieved posts with placeholders | The database is empty, and a stand-in for the X API returns one post | "Need namin ng tubig sa Malanday, call 0917 123 4567 o email tulong\@example.com, details https://t.co/abc123" | The researcher starts the retrieval of new posts | The stored post has its phone number, email address, and link each replaced with a placeholder, and the rest of its text is unchanged |  |  |
| FT-04 | Retrieve posts from X | The system shall request the posts that match the search keywords | The database is empty, and a stand-in for the X API records the request it receives | None | The researcher starts the retrieval of new posts | The request contains every word form in @tbl-keyword-forms |  |  |
| FT-05 | Open the prototype | The system shall show the list of labeled posts when it is opened in a web browser | The server is running, and the database holds P1 to P6 with their fixed labels | P1 to P6 | The responder opens the address of the prototype in a web browser | The list shows six posts |  |  |
| FT-06 | View the labeled posts | The system shall show each post with its text, its humanitarian category, and its highlighted entities | Same as FT-05 | P1 to P6 | The responder opens the prototype and goes through the list | Each of the six posts shows its text, its humanitarian category, and its entities as listed in @tbl-functional-test-posts |  |  |
| FT-07 | View the category of a post | The system shall show the humanitarian category that the final model assigned to each post | Same as FT-05 | P1 | The responder finds P1 in the list | P1 shows the category Requests or urgent needs |  |  |
| FT-08 | View the entities of a post | The system shall highlight each entity in the text of a post with its entity type | Same as FT-05 | P2 | The responder finds P2 in the list | "Signal No. 3" is highlighted as NUMBER, "Quezon" as LOCATION, and "Bagyong Henry" as DISASTER_TYPE |  |  |
| FT-09 | View the entities of a post | The system shall highlight each entity in the text of a post with its entity type | Same as FT-05 | P4 | The responder finds P4 in the list | P4 shows its text with nothing highlighted |  |  |
| FT-10 | Filter posts by category | The system shall show only the posts assigned the categories that the responder selects | Same as FT-05 | P1 to P6 | The responder selects Requests or urgent needs in the category filter | The list shows only P1 and P6 |  |  |
| FT-11 | Filter posts by category | The system shall show only the posts assigned the categories that the responder selects | Same as FT-05 | P1 to P6 | The responder selects Requests or urgent needs and Caution and advice in the category filter | The list shows only P1, P2, and P6 |  |  |
| FT-12 | Filter posts by entity type | The system shall show only the posts that contain at least one entity of the entity types that the responder selects | Same as FT-05 | P1 to P6 | The responder selects LOCATION in the entity type filter | The list shows only P1, P2, P5, and P6 |  |  |
| FT-13 | Filter posts by entity type | The system shall show only the posts that contain at least one entity of the entity types that the responder selects | Same as FT-05 | P1 to P6 | The responder selects REQUEST and ORGANIZATION in the entity type filter | The list shows only P1, P3, and P6 |  |  |
| FT-14 | Combine filters | The system shall show only the posts that match both the selected categories and the selected entity types | Same as FT-05 | P1 to P6 | The responder selects Requests or urgent needs and Caution and advice in the category filter, and REQUEST in the entity type filter | The list shows only P1 and P6 |  |  |
| FT-15 | Combine filters | The system shall show only the posts that match both the selected categories and the selected entity types | Same as FT-05 | P1 to P6 | The responder selects Sympathy and support in the category filter and LOCATION in the entity type filter | The list shows no posts |  |  |
| FT-16 | Clear filters | The system shall show every post again when the responder removes all selected categories and entity types | The filters of FT-14 are selected | P1 to P6 | The responder clears the filters | The list shows all six posts |  |  |
